Mu is a fictional or pseudoarchaeological lost continent idea popularized by James Churchward in the early twentieth century, especially in The Lost Continent of Mu. Churchward claimed Mu was a vast Pacific motherland of humanity, but mainstream scholarship treats the claim as unsupported pseudoarchaeology and a modern lost-world legend.
